exposure: use of mechanical ventilation and oxygen
associated causes and complications (e.g., NPO length due to surgical problems, feeding intolerance, necrotizing enterocolitis)
outcome: deviation from the Fenton preterm growth chart
cohort: The study recruited 255 preterm singleton infants born at the Afzalipour Medical Education and Health Center in Kerman, Iran.
finding: Deviation from the Fenton preterm growth chart was frequently observed in the cohort, increasing from 42.7% at discharge to 52.5% at six months, with weight at discharge and the length of NPO being significantly inversely related to growth outcomes.
